candidates.sentence: You have demonstrated strong support for sexual and reproductive health and rights, and we feel confident you will be a dedicated advocate for Planned Parenthood health centers and the people they serve when you are elected to the House in 2020,” wrote Alexis McGill Johnson, Acting President of Planned Parenthood Action Fund.

“You have been a strong supporter of women’s health and we know you will continue to be a dedicated advocate for Planned Parenthood Federation of America,” said Planned Parenthood Action Fund President Cecile Richards in the endorsement letter.
The PP Federal PAC supports federal candidates who are pro-family planning and support access to safe and legal abortion.
